name: Epipolar Ray Intersection
aliases: Epipolar Ray Intersection — Get Depth, Lift 2D Points to 3D via Epipolar Lines
Lift 2D Points to 3D via Epipolar Lines
definition: Calculates the 3D positions and depths corresponding to specified 2D points on epipolar lines defined by camera origins and directions, using image extrinsics and intrinsics.
summary: Epipolar Ray Intersection lifts 2D image points to 3D space by intersecting constructed rays with input world-space rays to find precise 3D positions and depths.
